environment: Preserved Linux SH GCC 14.1.0, frozen LTO link inputs
method: Recompiled runtime replacements and linked each payload in a new output directory. Applied the 512-byte external header, then compared full-file SHA-256 to the historic release.

isolatedSnapshot.procedure: In a fresh Linux mount namespace, only the extracted release snapshot was visible at /root/khicas-work. The installed historical cross toolchain was supplied separately. Ran tools/relink.py --run for both variants, prepended each external header and verified each digest against evidence/builds.json.
